title: intel.creator.hidden v1 payload
description: An account chose (hidden=true) or undid (hidden=false) "Don't recommend this creator" (Tara Intelligence WP 7.5-B2). Ids only; at is when the choice was made. Emitted by feed in the feedback transaction, behind INTEL_EMIT_R4_EVENTS (default on). Consumer: graph (drops the creator from the account's people suggestions).
